arxiv-2110-01850.title: Nonlinear effects of instantaneous and delayed state dependence in a delayed feedback loop
arxiv-2110-01850.creator: Antony R. Humphries, Bernd Krauskopf, Stefan Ruschel, and Jan Sieber, [0.5cm] Departments of Mathematics & Statistics, and, PhysiologyMcGill University, Montreal, Quebec H3A 0B9, Canada, [.2cm] Department of Mathematics, Dodd-Walls Centre for Photonic andQuantum Technologies University of Auckland,
arxiv-2110-01850.description: Abstract We study a scalar, first-order delay differential equation (DDE) with instantaneous and state-dependent delayed feedback, which itself may be delayed. The state dependence introduces nonlinearity into an otherwise linear system. We investigate the ensuing nonlinear dynamics with the case of instantaneous state dependence as our starting point.

arxiv-2310-01001.creator: Julie Parreaux, Jakob Piribauer, Christel Baier
arxiv-2310-01001.description: Abstract Investigations of causality in operational systems aim at providing human-understandable explanations of why a system behaves as it does. There is, in particular, a demand to explain what went wrong on a given counterexample execution that shows that a system does not satisfy a given specification.

arxiv-2311-14239.title: Allpass impulse response modelling
arxiv-2311-14239.creator: Matthew R Flax <flatmax@flatmax.org>
arxiv-2311-14239.description: Abstract This document defines a method for FIR system modelling which is very trivial as it only depends on phase introduction and removal (allpass filters). As magnitude is not altered, the processing is numerically stable. It is limited to phase alteration which maintains the time domain magnitude to force a system within its linear limits.

arxiv-2410-19692.title: AGENT-CQ: Automatic Generation and Evaluation of Clarifying Questions for Conversational Search with LLMs

arxiv-2410-19692.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Clemencia Siro‡ Yifei Yuan§ Mohammad Aliannejadi‡ Maarten de Rijke‡. Generating diverse and effective clarifying questions is crucial for improving query understanding and retrieval performance in open-domain CS ( CS ) systems. We propose AGENT-CQ ( A utomatic GEN eration, and evalua T ion of C larifying Q uestions), an end-to-end LLM-based framework addressing the challenges of scalability and adaptability faced by existing methods that rely on manual curation or template-based approaches.

arxiv-2502-09271.title: LiSA: Leveraging Link Recommender to Attack Graph Neural Networks via Subgraph Injection
arxiv-2502-09271.creator: Wenlun Zhang, Enyan Dai✉, Kentaro Yoshioka
arxiv-2502-09271.description: Abstract Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have demonstrated remarkable proficiency in modeling data with graph structures, yet recent research reveals their susceptibility to adversarial attacks. Traditional attack methodologies, which rely on manipulating the original graph or adding links to artificially created nodes, often prove impractical in real-world settings.

arxiv-2504-08681.description: Abstract In this note we demonstrate that locally optimal functional quantizers for probability distributions P P on a Banach space lying in the support of P P behave exactly like globally optimal functional quantizers in terms of stationarity. Keywords: functional quantization ; stationary quantizer ; locally optimal quantizers. 1 Introduction We will use the notations of [ 1 ] .

arxiv-2509-18119.title: MobileRL: Online Agentic Reinforcement Learning for Mobile GUI Agents
arxiv-2509-18119.creator: Yifan Xu, Xiao Liu, Xinghan Liu, Jiaqi Fu, Hanchen Zhang, Bohao Jing, Shudan Zhang, Yuting Wang, Wenyi Zhao, Yuxiao Dong
arxiv-2509-18119.description: Abstract Building general-purpose graphical user interface (GUI) agents has become increasingly promising with the progress in vision language models. However, developing effective mobile GUI agents with reinforcement learning (RL) remains challenging due to the heavy-tailed distribution of task difficulty and the inefficiency of large-scale environment sampling.

arxiv-2511-14417.title: Nonlinear Coherence for Vector Time Series: Defining Region-to-Region Functional Brain Connectivity

arxiv-2511-14417.description: Abstract Alterations in functional brain connectivity characterize neurodegenerative disorders such as Alzheimer’s disease (AD) and frontotemporal dementia (FTD). As a non-invasive and cost-effective technique, electroencephalography (EEG) is gaining increasing attention for its potential to identify reliable biomarkers for early detection and differential diagnosis of AD and FTD.

arxiv-2601-18949.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Cole Granger, Dipin Khati, Daniel Rodriguez-Cardenas, Denys Poshyvanyk. Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly integrated into software development workflows, yet they often introduce subtle logic or data-misuse errors that differ from human bugs. To study how these two error types interact, we construct Tricky 2 , a hybrid dataset that augments the existing TrickyBugs ( 14 ) corpus of human-written defects with errors injected by both GPT-5 and OpenAI-oss-20b across C++, Python, and Java programs.

pmc-10640817.creator: Xinjie Wang, Zhongren Zheng, Jialiang Wang, Hui Ma, Guodong Wang, Xiaowei Zhao
pmc-10640817.description: BackgroundCurrently, there is no single test indicator for diagnosing periprosthetic joint infection (PJI) with an acceptable level of sensitivity. pmc-12388405.title: Insights into the Genomic Architecture and Improvement of the Capabilities of Acinetobacter calcoaceticus for the Biodegradation of Petroleum Hydrocarbons
pmc-12388405.creator: Yaning Zeng, Mutian Wang, Xiaoyu Chang, Leilei Wang, Xiaowen Fu, Yujie Huang, Fanyong Song, Lei Ji, Jianing Wang
pmc-12388405.description: Petroleum-contaminated terrestrial ecosystems require effective bioremediation strategies. In this study, genomic analysis revealed key biodegradation genes on the Acinetobacter calcoaceticus 21# chromosome: alkane hydroxylases (alkB, almA, LadA) and aromatic ortho-cleavage pathway genes (catABC). Phylogenetic and multiple sequence alignment analyses of the almA gene in strain 21# revealed the presence of signature motifs characteristic of Baeyer–Villiger monooxygenase.

pmc-12494618.title: Impact of tumor number on the efficacy of lenvatinib in borderline resectable hepatocellular carcinoma
pmc-12494618.creator: Naokazu Chiba, Takumi Seichi, Masashi Nakagawa, Shigeto Ochiai, Takahiro Gunji, Toru Sano, Junichi Taira, Katsuya Kitamura, Shigeyuki Kawachi
pmc-12494618.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundThe global incidence of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) is steadily rising, and the disease is associated with poor survival outcomes. As a multicentric cancer with a high recurrence rate, surgical resection alone is often not sufficient for a curative treatment. This study aimed to identify factors that predict its efficacy in patients with HCC classified as borderline resectable according to the BR-HCC Expert Consensus 2023.MethodsThis study retrospectively analyzed 30 patients with borderline resectable HCC who were treated with Lenvatinib as their initial therapy.

pmc-12996691.description: BackgroundAcute heart failure (AHF) has high early mortality. The FIB-4 index indicates hepatic dysfunction in AHF, but its predictive power for short-term outcomes in developing countries is not well established.MethodsWe conducted a prospective cohort study at Can Tho Central General Hospital, Vietnam, from May to December 2024 including adults aged ≥18, hospitalized with AHF and NT-proBNP levels ≥300 pg/mL.

pmc-13198506.title: Evaluation of an experimental model of senescence SAMR1/SAMP8 for microRNA studies in acute myocardial infarction: role of sex and aging
pmc-13198506.creator: A B Paes, B Descals-Beltrán, C Rosales-Ariza, A Díaz, D Pérez-Cremades, A P Dantas, C Hermenegildo, S Novella
pmc-13198506.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Age and sex are critical yet often overlooked variables in preclinical models of acute myocardial infarction (AMI), potentially limiting the translational relevance of molecular findings. In this study, we used the Senescence-Accelerated Mouse Prone 8 (SAMP8) strain, a model of age-related cardiovascular dysfunction, alongside age-matched SAMR1 controls, to investigate early expression patterns of four canonical circulating miRNA biomarkers of AMI: miR-1-3p, miR-133a-3p, miR-208a-3p, and miR-499-5p.

pmc-13349292.description: IntroductionPatient adherence to orthodontic treatment depends on comfort, absence of pain, and improved quality of life. Pain and discomfort from procedures like interproximal separation or appliance activation are often underestimated by professionals. Low-level laser therapy, with minimal side effects, shows potential for pain relief in orthodontics, though its efficacy remains uncertain.

pmc-13536454.title: Efficacy of cryotherapy for oral leukoplakia: A systematic review
pmc-13536454.creator: Chuan-Hang Yu, Tzu-Chen Chan, Chun-Pin Chiang
pmc-13536454.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Oral leukoplakia (OL) is the most common oral potentially malignant disorder and carries a risk of malignant transformation. Cryotherapy is a minimally invasive treatment option for OL, but its efficacy and optimal dose–response remain inconsistent among various studies. This systematic review evaluated the clinical efficacy and safety of cryotherapy for OL lesions and explored whether the characteristics of the lesions and treatment parameters influenced clinical outcomes.
